content: OTP supervision for projectors: each projector is a GenServer under a Supervisor or DynamicSupervisor. Placement: under a dedicated Orkestra.Projection.Supervisor (not mixed with write-side handlers). Restart strategy: :transient (restart on crash, but NOT on {:stop, :halted} which is a clean shutdown with :shutdown reason). DynamicSupervisor allows adding projectors at runtime (useful for rebuild). Static projectors declared in mix config can use a plain Supervisor with :one_for_one. The Projection.Supervisor itself is a child of the application supervisor, alongside MessageBus and EventStore supervisors. Projector state: GenServer state holds {status: :running|:halted|:replaying, checkpoint: integer, retry_count: integer, current_event: event|nil}.
